answer: Reaching eligibility takes 70 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary pays for every seat it wants. The garden register is checked at draw time, sparrow lists the eligible set, and mirror seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 70 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. That is 17 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
